description: This file implements the core logic of the AppManager component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It manages application lifecycle events, package handling, property storage, and communication with other system components. The code includes methods for registering notifications, launching, closing, and terminating apps, as well as handling app installation status and configuration.

classes.name: AppManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements application management functionalities including lifecycle control, package handling, notification registration, and property storage within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event with parameters to the worker pool.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles various app events and notifies registered observers.

methods.name: handleOnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Notifies clients about app lifecycle state changes.

methods.name: handleOnAppUnloaded
methods.description: Notifies clients when an app is unloaded.

methods.name: handleOnAppLaunchRequest

methods.name: Configure

methods.name: releasePersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
